subject: Bridge access request — PO stuck in legal review
messages:
From: Sven Larson <sven.larson@cloverhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@cloverhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Bridge access request — PO stuck in legal review

Hi Ben,

Quick note from our side — legal has put the PO through another round of review after some clause clarifications. Procurement expects the signature to clear but it may take 2–3 weeks. We have a small team ready to validate the integration and run performance tests this week; however the sandbox access on your end will expire in 5 days.

Is there any way you can provide short-term access or provisional credits so we can continue the evaluation while the PO is in the legal queue? We won’t start production workloads — just a constrained test suite (roughly 40k tokens/day). If helpful, attaching the current PO draft.

Thanks — really appreciate any flexibility.

Sven Larson
Head of ML, CloverHealth
Sven.larson@cloverhealth.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: clover_po_draft.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sven Larson <sven.larson@cloverhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@cloverhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridge access request — PO stuck in legal review

Hi Sven — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the draft.

We can usually support short-term access in cases like this. A couple quick questions to scope the request:
- Do you want a time-boxed credit grant (we typically do 14–30 days) or temporary sandbox access tied to the account?
- Rough daily tokens / compute profile (you mentioned ~40k tokens/day; is that steady or spiky?)

I’ve looped in Marissa (Customer Success) so we can coordinate the environment and track usage. If you confirm the duration and expected consumption, I’ll start the internal approval and get an offer over.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (650) 555-0124

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: approval request — temporary promo credits for CloverHealth

Marissa / Lauren — quick ask: CloverHealth (DEAL-8291) has a PO that got pulled into legal; they need an evaluation runway for ~2–3 weeks so the ML team can complete performance validation. They’re asking for either sandbox access or a short-term credit grant for testing (~40k tokens/day).

Proposed offer: $5,000 in promo credits, valid for 21 days, usage capped and restricted to non-production/test environments. No discounts beyond the trial credit; credits expire automatically.

Reason: high likelihood of conversion in Q1, large pilot potential, and they’ve already committed to a multi-month Dedicated plan in the PO draft.

Attachments: clover_po_draft.pdf (from customer) — included for context.

Can you confirm approval? If green, I’ll draft the note to the customer and include the terms.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: approval request — temporary promo credits for CloverHealth

Ben — I reviewed the PO and the account history. Approve $5,000 promo credits for 21 days with the restrictions you listed. Please ensure:
- Credits are flagged in billing as promotional (non-refundable)
- Usage caps are enforced and we have an alert if they exceed 75% of the grant in any 72-hour window
- Marissa to own onboarding/observe for quality/regression checks

I’m attaching a short approval note for records.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations
Attachment: promo-approval-note.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sven Larson <sven.larson@cloverhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@cloverhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridge access request — PO stuck in legal review

Sven — good news. We can grant a provisional credit package to keep your evaluation uninterrupted while legal finishes the PO. Details below: 

- Grant: $5,000 in promotional credits
- Duration: 21 days from grant date (expires automatically)
- Usage: capped to test/sandbox endpoints; no production traffic. If you need sandbox environment credentials we’ll provision those separately.
- Safeguards: we’ll enable usage alerts (75% threshold) and a hard cap to prevent accidental overages.
- Terms: credits are non-refundable and applied only to usage; standard TOS applies.

I’ve attached the approval note. Marissa will reach out to set up access and monitoring. Please confirm if 21 days works for your timeline and whether you want the credits applied today or on Monday so it aligns with your team’s schedule.

Ben

Attachment: promo-approval-note.pdf (application/pdf)

Ben — thank you, this is exactly what we needed. Please apply the credits today so our team can pick things up Monday morning. We’ll stick to the sandbox and won’t exceed the stated limits. I’ll also share a brief validation plan and schedule a 30-minute check-in with Marissa next week.

Appreciate the quick turn-around, and we’ll keep you updated if legal lands the PO sooner.

Sven
